title: Magic squares: does one fixed entry determine the rest?
question: Do fixed line sums and half-turn symmetry make either LP1 five-by-five square unique once one entry is fixed?
summary: No: five rational degrees of freedom remain after fixing any one entry. Fifty positive-integer counterexamples preserve the chosen cell and all required sums and symmetry.

family.title: Magic-square constraints and freedom
family.question: Which explicit numerical constraints determine or restrict a magic square?

scope.representation: LP1-05 rune words converted by additive Gematria Primus prime values; LP1-16 decimal grid. Row-major rational variables for comparison models.
scope.procedure: Exact rational RREF of fixed-line-sum difference constraints; separate none, half-turn, transpose and combined models. Add a fixed-cell constraint at every position for half-turn models. Construct and check positive-integer changes to the two archived 5x5 grids.
scope.parameters: Orders 3, 5, 7; four symmetry models each (12 cases). All cells fixed individually for half-turn dimensions. 25 positions per actual page (50 witness cases); first primitive null direction, plus then minus one step only.
scope.exclusions: No other primality, distinctness, normal-square or server-validation requirements; no enumeration of all positive grids; no historical 7x7 transcription or cipher search.

finding: Uniqueness is not supported under the stated rules: half-turn dimensions are 6 for order 5 and 16 for order 7 before fixing an entry, then 5 and 15 respectively. All 50 actual-grid fixed-cell cases have a verified positive-integer alternative.
limitations: Not an enumeration of integer solutions, primality constraints, normal squares, historical server criteria, author intentions or an unsolved-page cipher. Order seven is a mathematical comparison, not a checked historical grid.
next_steps: Treat additional fixed entries, allowed-value lists or prime-pattern requirements as explicit variants; integer enumeration requires separate bounds and lattice treatment.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12 standard library. Independent checks: python experiments/records/magic-square-freedom/check.py

review.reviewer: Codex; exact rerun and separately implemented modular-rank and direct-witness checks; human review pending
